title: Create Automotive Ads for Models
content_data:
This article walks you through the steps to create Automotive Ads for Models. # Introduction Automotive Ads for Models leverage the model and offer information stored in your Auto-Model catalog to showcase the most relevant vehicles to potential buyers. Buyers can interact with the ads to enter their zip code, then view and filter available models on an Instant Product Page based on attributes such as make, model, price, year, and more. This gives buyers a streamlined way to browse and identify vehicles that meet their needs directly from your ad. **You can use Campaign Management API to create Automotive Ads for Models, and this helps you streamline your ad creation experience, and elevate operational efficiency and scalability.** # Prerequisites - You've gained access to TikTok API for Business. See [Get Started - Step by step workflow](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1735713609895937) for details. - To create Automotive Ads for Models, you need relevant permissions. See [API Reference](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1735713875563521) to find out permissions required for endpoints (including the endpoints listed in the "Steps" section) and see [Update app permissions](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738855280338946) to find out how to configure permissions. - Creating Automotive Ads for Models requires setting up an Auto-Model catalog in Business Center first.
To set up the catalog: 1. Create an Auto-Model catalog using [/catalog/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740306481704961). 2. Upload products to the catalog using [/catalog/product/upload/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740497429681153) (JSON schema), [/catalog/product/file/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740496787164161) (CSV feed template), or [/catalog/feed/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740665161957377)(online data feed schedule). 3. Check the product handling results using [/catalog/product/log/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740570027173889).
Pass in the `feed_log_id` obtained from Step 2. If the field `warn_affected_products` in the response is not null, examine the issue details and return to Step 2 to reupload the product. 4. (Optional) Create an Auto-Model product set using [/catalog/set/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740572891104257).
If you want to have products selected from a product set at the ad level, creating a product set is necessary. Otherwise, you can skip this step. 5. (Optional) Invite members to Business Center and grant the admin permission using [/bc/member/invite/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739939455765505).
You can also choose `advertiser_role` that you want to assign to the members invited. 6. (Optional) Share a catalog with members and grant catalog management access using [/bc/asset/assign/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739438211077121).
Make sure to specify `CATALOG` in the `asset_type` field and `ADMIN` in the `catalog_role` field. # Steps ## 1. Create a campaign Create a campaign using [/campaign/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739318962329602). Note that the following requirements must be met.
Setting Requirement Parameter How to configure the parameter
Advertising objective Lead generation objective_type LEAD_GENERATION
Smart+ Campaign Disabled

You cannot use /campaign/spc/create/ to create a Smart+ Automotive Campaign for Models.		 / /
iOS 14 Dedicated Campaign Disabled campaign_type REGULAR_CAMPAIGN or not passed
app_id Not passed
campaign_app_profile_page_state Not passed
Use catalog Enabled catalog_enabled true

Create an ad group Create an ad group using [/adgroup/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739499616346114). Note that the following requirements must be met.
Setting Requirement Parameter How to configure the parameter
Product source An Auto-Model catalog with at least one approved product product_source CATALOG
catalog_id
catalog_authorized_bc_id		 Pass valid values.

The Auto-Model catalog (catalog_id) needs to have at least one approved product. You can verify this by checking the value of approved returned from /catalog/overview/, which should be at least 1.

To learn about how to create an Auto-Model catalog, see Prerequisites.
Optimization location
(Promotion type)		 Website
  • If you want to use the optimization goal Conversions, specify a TikTok Pixel and the corresponding optimization event.
  • If you want to use the optimization goal Click, do not specify TikTok Pixel and the corresponding optimization event.
 promotion_type LEAD_GENERATION
promotion_target_type EXTERNAL_WEBSITE
pixel_id
optimization_event
  • If optimization_goal is CONVERT, pass in pixel_id and optimization_event at the same time.
  • If optimization_goal is CLICK, do not pass in pixel_id and optimization_event.

To obtain Pixels with their associated optimization events, use /pixel/list/.
Deep funnel optimization
(Optional)		 Enabled or disabled

With deep funnel optimization, you can select a secondary event alongside the primary optimization event, which can help improve campaign effectiveness.		 deep_funnel_optimization_status
deep_funnel_event_source
deep_funnel_event_source_id
deep_funnel_optimization_event
  • To enable deep funnel optimization, set deep_funnel_optimization_status to ON and pass deep_funnel_event_source, deep_funnel_event_source_id, and deep_funnel_optimization_event.
  • To disable deep funnel optimization, set deep_funnel_optimization_status to OFF or leave deep_funnel_optimization_status unspecified. Do not pass deep_funnel_event_source, deep_funnel_event_source_id, and deep_funnel_optimization_event.

Note:

  • Deep funnel optimization with CRM events is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative.
  • Deep funnel optimization with Pixel or Offline events is generally available.
Placement Select Placement with TikTok placement only placement_type PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL
placements ["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK"]
Include search results Disabled search_result_enabled false or not passed
Audience targeting
· Demographics - Location		 The location should match or be the subset of the targeting location of your catalog. location_ids IDs of locations that match or are a subset of the targeting location of catalog_id.
Audience targeting
· Demographics - zip code targeting		 Supported when the targeting location of your catalog is in the United States. zipcode_ids Supported when the targeting location of catalog_id is in the United States.
Audience targeting
· Demographics - Age		 Audiences younger than 18 years old can't be targeted. age_groups Do not pass the value AGE_13_17.
Content exclusions - Inventory filter Supported with allowlist brand_safety_type Pass a valid value (EXPANDED_INVENTORY, STANDARD_INVENTORY, or LIMITED_INVENTORY) or not passed

Note: TikTok inventory filter is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative.
brand_safety_partner Not passed
Content exclusions - Category exclusions Disabled category_exclusion_ids Not passed
Content exclusions - Vertical sensitivity control Disabled vertical_sensitivity_id Not passed
Optimization goal Any of the following options:
  • Conversions
  • Click
 optimization_goal Any of the following values:
  • CONVERT
  • CLICK
Attribution settings
(supported only if Optimization goal is Conversions)		 The supported Click-through windows are:
  • 1-day click
  • 7-day click
  • 14-day click
  • 28-day click
 click_attribution_window If optimization_goal is CONVERT, the supported values are:
  • ONE_DAY
  • SEVEN_DAYS
  • FOURTEEN_DAYS
  • TWENTY_EIGHT_DAYS
The supported View-through windows are:
  • Off
  • 1-day view
  • 7-day view
 view_attribution_window If optimization_goal is CONVERT, the supported values are:
  • OFF
  • ONE_DAY
  • SEVEN_DAYS
The supported Engaged view-through windows are:
  • Off
  • 1-day engaged view
  • 7-day engaged view
  • 14-day engaged view
  • 28-day engaged view
 engaged_view_attribution_window If optimization_goal is CONVERT, the supported values are:
  • OFF
  • ONE_DAY
  • SEVEN_DAYS
  • FOURTEEN_DAYS
  • TWENTY_EIGHT_DAYS
The supported Event count options are:
  • Once
  • Every
 attribution_event_count If optimization_goal is CONVERT, the supported values are:
  • ONCE
  • EACH
Billing event
  • If Optimization goal is set to Conversions, set Billing event to oCPM.
  • If Optimization goal is set to Click, set Billing event to CPC.
 billing_event
  • If optimization_goal is set to CLICK, specify billing_event as CPC.
  • If optimization_goal is set to CONVERT, specify billing_event as OCPM.
Bid strategy
& Delivery type
  • If Bid strategy is set to Cost Cap, you can set Delivery type to Standard or Accelerated.
  • If Bid strategy is set to Maximum Delivery, you can only set Delivery type to Standard.
 bid_type
pacing
  • If you specify bid_type as BID_TYPE_CUSTOM, you can set pacing to PACING_MODE_SMOOTH or PACING_MODE_FAST.
  • If you specify bid_type as BID_TYPE_NO_BID, you can only set pacing to PACING_MODE_SMOOTH.
Split test Disabled

Automotive Ad Groups for Models cannot be used in /split_test/create/ to create split tests.		 / /

  • If Destination is Vehicle Inventory Page (landing_page_url is not passed), the value of this field will default to AUTO_INVENTORY_INSTANT_PAGE.
  • If Destination is Website URL (landing_page_url is passed), the value of this field will be null. If you manually specify a value that is not null, the value will be ignored.
Interactive add-on Inventory Card.

For Automotive Ads for Models with Single Video format, auto-generated Vehicle Cards will be shown after two seconds of video play. If the audience continues swiping through the Vehicle Cards, the Inventory Card will be displayed at the end.

The Inventory Card includes:
  • A customized image
  • A customized description
  • CTA button "Search Inventory", which directs the audience to an auto-generated Instant Product Page
 card_id Specify the ID of an Inventory Card portfolio.
To get the Inventory Card portfolio ID (creative_portfolio_id), see Cards.

The Inventory Card includes a CTA button and the following attributes of the Inventory Card:
  • image_id
  • description
To get the details of an Inventory Card, use /creative/portfolio/list/.
Call to action Enabled.
The recommended setting is "Check availability".		 call_to_action Pass a valid value.
The recommended value is CHECK_AVAILABLILITY.
To get other supported values, see Enumerations - Call-to-action.
Destination Any of the following options:
  • Website URL: Your own URL to direct users to browse inventory on your website.
  • Vehicle Inventory Page: The Instant Product Page to access your full Vehicle Catalog.
    • If Destination is Vehicle Inventory Page, an Instant Product Page will be automatically generated.
landing_page_url
